rows.grounds: compound of lalāṭa varṇa rāśi stha; situated in forehead syllable mass
compound sura arcita; worshipped by gods

items.question: What quantity of forehead-syllable practice must be completed after worshipping the god?
items.inference: The practitioner completes hundred thousand repetitions of the forehead syllable after worshipping the god.
uncertainties: Exact ritual object of lakṣaṃ is not specified in this verse.
items.plain_english: Having worshipped the god, one completes a hundred thousand repetitions of the syllable situated in the forehead mass.
